title: A different Saturday plan
paragraphs: Last Saturday, I met my friend Maya at a small library. We wanted a quiet place to read, but there was a notice on the door. The library was going to close early that day because a pipe needed repairs. We had only one hour.

At first, Maya was disappointed. She had a long list of things to do. Then the librarian showed us a table with free books. Some were old travel guides, and others were short stories. We each chose one book and sat outside in the sun. A child nearby asked Maya about the pictures in her book. They talked for ten minutes.

On the way home, Maya said, “Next weekend, I am going to bring my younger brother here. He thinks every library is silent and boring.” I told her about the book box near my school. Now we have a new plan. We are going to collect a few books for it and leave a short note inside each one.
Our morning did not follow the plan, but it gave us a better idea. Sometimes a small change can show you a place in a different way.
translation: 上星期六，我和朋友玛雅在一家小图书馆见面，想找安静的地方读书。但门上贴了通知：因为水管维修，图书馆当天会提早关门。我们只有一小时。
起初玛雅很失望，她计划做很多事。后来管理员带我们看了一张摆着免费书籍的桌子。有旧旅行指南，也有短篇故事。我们各选了一本，坐到户外晒太阳。旁边一个孩子问玛雅书里的图片，两人聊了十分钟。
回家路上玛雅说：“下周末我打算带弟弟来。他觉得图书馆都是安静又无聊的。”我向她介绍学校附近的书箱。我们有了新计划：收集几本书放进去，并在每本书里留一张短笺。
早晨没有按计划进行，却给了我们更好的想法。有时一个小变化会让你从不同角度认识一个地方。

questions.prompt: Why did the library close early?
questions.explanation: 第一段明确交代水管需要维修。

questions.prompt: Why does Maya want to bring her brother?
options: She wants him to repair the pipe.
She needs him to buy a travel guide.
She wants him to see a different side of libraries.
questions.explanation: 孩子与玛雅的交谈，和弟弟觉得图书馆无聊形成对照。

questions.prompt: What does “I am going to bring my younger brother here” express?
options: A plan Maya has already formed.
An action that finished last year.
questions.explanation: 这里going to说明已经形成的未来意图。

questions.prompt: Which title fits the message of the story?
options: A changed plan can bring a new idea.
Never visit a place without a list.
questions.explanation: 末段直接总结计划变化带来的新发现。

questions.prompt: Why does the writer mention Maya’s younger brother?
options: To prove all children dislike books.
To explain why the pipe broke.
To show how the visit may change someone’s idea of a library.
questions.explanation: Her brother considers libraries silent and boring; the conversation outside gives Maya a reason to bring him and broaden that view.

notes: 过去时叙述当天经历，going to转到已形成的未来计划。
阅读时先找事件如何改变，再判断作者的态度。
